tools.name: signup
tools.description: Signup for SalesBlink - Returns a magic sign-up link where a new user can create an account.

tools.name: get_all_lists
tools.description: Get All Lists - Retrieve all contact lists with optional filtering. Note: boolean filters (starred/archived) are unreliable. Supported filters: folder, search, sortBy, sortType, integration. Each list includes a `fields` array — the list's columns in snake_case (e.g. first_name, email, lead_score).

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create a List - Create a new contact list. Contacts added to lists must originate from an evidenced import or consent source that the account holder already has (e.g. their own opt-in list, CRM export, or inbound leads) — not addresses assembled by the model. The response includes a `fields` array —

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Get a Specific List - Retrieve details of a specific contact list. The response includes a `fields` array — the list's columns in snake_case (e.g. first_name, email, lead_score).

tools.name: update_list
tools.description: Update a List - Update list properties. Archiving is handled by archive_list.

tools.name: get_all_templates
tools.description: Get All Templates - Retrieve all email templates with optional filtering. Note: boolean filters (starred/archived) are unreliable. Supported filters: folder, type, taskType, search, sortBy, sortType.

tools.name: create_template
tools.description: Create a Template - Create a new email template. Attachments are not supported on this connector — to send files, attach them via the SalesBlink web app.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get a Specific Template - Retrieve details of a specific email template. Template tests are included when includeTests is true.

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Update a Template - Update an existing email template. Attachments are not supported on this connector — to send files, attach them via the SalesBlink web app.

tools.name: get_inbox_threads
tools.description: Get Inbox Threads - Retrieve inbox threads with optional filtering. Note: only type, sequence, search, date, sender, limit, and skip are applied by the API.

tools.name: get_thread_messages
tools.description: Get Thread Messages - Retrieve all messages in a specific thread

tools.name: send_reply
tools.description: Send a Reply - Send a reply to a specific message thread. Attachments are not supported on this connector — to send files, attach them via the SalesBlink web app.

tools.name: forward_inbox_message
tools.description: Forward Inbox Message - Forward an email to another recipient. Attachments are not supported on this connector — to send files, attach them via the SalesBlink web app.

tools.name: update_mail_state
tools.description: Update Mail State - Mark emails as read/unread or update outcome

tools.name: get_all_sequences
tools.description: Get All Sequences - Retrieve all sequences with optional filtering. Note: boolean filters (starred/archived) and owned_by are unreliable. Supported filters: search, status, folder, sortBy, sortType, sendAll.

tools.name: create_sequence
tools.description: Create a Sequence - Create a new email sequence/campaign. Recipients must be the account holder's own contactable audience (e.g. their own opt-in or otherwise consented contacts) — never addresses assembled by the model — and suppression/blocklist is always enforced. Sequences are created paused by

tools.name: get_sequence
tools.description: Get a Specific Sequence - Retrieve details of a specific sequence

tools.name: update_sequence
tools.description: Update Sequence Properties and State. Archiving is handled by archive_sequence. Recipients must be the account holder's own contactable audience and suppression/blocklist is always enforced. Changing launch settings to start sending emails must only happen after explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: get_sequence_stats
tools.description: Get Sequence Stats - Retrieve statistics for a specific sequence

tools.name: get_all_users
tools.description: Get All Users - Retrieve all users in the account. Note: pagination and filtering parameters are accepted for compatibility but currently have no effect — the endpoint returns every user in the account with no pagination or filtering.

tools.name: add_user
tools.description: Add a User - Invite a new user to your account

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get a Specific User - Retrieve a specific user by ID from the account user list. The public API only exposes GET /users, so the tool fetches the full list and returns the matching user.

tools.name: update_user
tools.description: Update a User - Update user properties

tools.name: generate_login_link
tools.description: Generate Login Link - Create a time-limited magic login link for the authenticated user

tools.name: get_all_senders
tools.description: Get All Email Senders - Retrieve all email sender accounts (flat list, not grouped by folder)

tools.name: get_all_folders
tools.description: Get All Folders - Retrieve all folders. The type filter supports 'all', 'general', and 'email-sender'. General folders (created without a type) hold lists, templates, and sequences; email-sender folders hold email senders only.

tools.name: add_contacts
tools.description: Add Contacts to a List - Add multiple contacts to an existing list. Contacts must come from an evidenced import or consent source that the account holder already has (e.g. their own opt-in list, CRM export, or inbound leads) — do not assemble addresses from model knowledge or web scraping. tools.name: remove_contact
tools.description: Remove a Contact from a List - Remove a single contact from a list by email

tools.name: get_sent_activity
tools.description: Get Sent Activity - Get list of sent emails

tools.name: get_opens_activity
tools.description: Get Opens Activity - Get list of email opens

tools.name: get_clicks_activity
tools.description: Get Clicks Activity - Get list of link clicks

tools.name: get_replies_activity
tools.description: Get Replies Activity - Get list of email replies

tools.name: archive_list
tools.description: Archive or Unarchive a List - Archive lists to remove them from active views

tools.name: archive_template
tools.description: Archive or Unarchive a Template - Archive email templates

tools.name: archive_sequence
tools.description: Archive or Unarchive a Sequence - Archive sequences to pause and hide them

tools.name: archive_contact
tools.description: Archive or Unarchive a Contact - Archive leads/contacts to remove from active campaigns

tools.name: get_leads
tools.description: Get Leads in a List - Retrieve all leads/contacts in a specific list. Supported filters: search, archived, sort, sequence, status.

tools.name: update_lead
tools.description: Update a Lead - Update lead/contact properties including custom fields. All field names use snake_case (e.g. first_name, company_name, lead_score). The `starred` boolean is a contact setting and is not added as a list column. Contact archiving is handled by archive_contact.

tools.name: move_lead
tools.description: Move Lead to Another List - Move a lead from one list to another

tools.name: get_all_workspaces
tools.description: Get All Workspaces - Retrieve all accessible workspaces (owner only)

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Create Workspace - Create a new workspace (owner only)

tools.name: update_workspace
tools.description: Update Workspace - Update workspace name (owner only)

tools.name: clone_sequence
tools.description: Clone a Sequence - Create a copy of an existing sequence

tools.name: get_inbox_placement_tests
tools.description: Get Inbox Placement Tests - Retrieve all deliverability tests

tools.name: create_inbox_placement_test
tools.description: Create Inbox Placement Test - Test email deliverability across providers

tools.name: pause_inbox_placement_test
tools.description: Pause Inbox Placement Test - Pause an active deliverability test

tools.name: delete_inbox_placement_test
tools.description: Delete Inbox Placement Test - Remove a deliverability test. Requires explicit user confirmation, since deletion cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_reports
tools.description: Get Reports - Retrieve activity reports with date filtering

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a Folder - Create a new folder for organizing items. The type field is supported only for email-sender folders; general folders for lists, templates, and sequences do not use it.

tools.name: get_warmup_links
tools.description: Get Warmup Links - Retrieve all warmup link configurations for sender warmup

tools.name: get_sender_connect_link
tools.description: Get Sender Connect Link - Returns a magic login link to the email-sender connection page where the user can connect a Gmail, Outlook, or SMTP/IMAP sender.

tools.name: get_bulk_senders_upload_link
tools.description: Get Bulk Senders Upload Link - Returns a magic login link to the email-sender connection page where the user can upload senders in bulk via CSV.

tools.name: initialize_google_oauth
tools.description: Initialize Google OAuth - Return the Google authorization URL for connecting a Gmail or Google Workspace sender.

tools.name: initialize_outlook_oauth
tools.description: Initialize Outlook OAuth - Return the Microsoft authorization URL for connecting an Outlook sender.

tools.name: get_custom_domains
tools.description: Get Custom Domains - Retrieve custom tracking domains for the workspace (including unverified domains with DNS setup instructions and status tags)

tools.name: get_signatures
tools.description: Get Email Signatures - Retrieve all email signatures

tools.name: get_api_keys
tools.description: Get API Keys - Retrieve all API keys for the account. For security, returned keys are masked (only the first and last 3 characters are shown, e.g. 'abc...xyz') — full key values are never exposed by this tool. To view or copy a full key, the account holder must use the API-key management page in the

tools.name: get_api_key_page_link
tools.description: Get API Key Page Link - Returns a magic login link to the API keys page where the user can create a new API key.

tools.name: get_api_key_refresh_link
tools.description: Get API Key Refresh Link - Returns a magic login link to the API keys page where the user can refresh an existing API key.

tools.name: delete_api_key
tools.description: Delete API Key - Revoke an API key. Requires explicit user confirmation, since revoking a key immediately breaks any live integration using it.

tools.name: update_sender
tools.description: Update Sender - Update email sender settings (warmup, inbox, signature, tracking domain, etc.)

tools.name: get_add_card_login_link
tools.description: Get Add Card Login Link - Generate a magic login link to add a payment card

tools.name: get_remove_card_login_link
tools.description: Get Remove Card Login Link - Generate a magic login link to remove a saved payment card

tools.name: get_analytics_overall
tools.description: Get Overall Analytics - Overall stats across all sequences

tools.name: get_analytics_daily
tools.description: Get Daily Analytics - Day-wise overall stats

tools.name: get_analytics_lead_stats
tools.description: Get Lead-level Analytics - Lead-level stats

tools.name: get_analytics_mailbox_stats
tools.description: Get Mailbox Analytics - Overall mailbox stats

tools.name: reconnect_sender
tools.description: Reconnect Sender - Reconnect a failed sender

tools.name: get_sender_health
tools.description: Get Sender Health - Get sender health and reputation score

tools.name: get_sender_warmup_stats
tools.description: Get Sender Warmup Stats - Date-wise warmup stats (sent, sent_replies, received, received_replies, spam_to_inbox) plus per-ESP breakdown (esp_info: google/outlook/others with totalCount and spam_to_inbox)

tools.name: fetch_sender_messages
tools.description: Fetch Sender Messages - Retrieve sent emails and received replies for a sender (max 50 messages, use skip for pagination)

tools.name: fetch_multiple_sender_messages
tools.description: Bulk Fetch Sender Messages - Retrieve sent emails and received replies across multiple senders (max 50 messages, use skip for pagination)

tools.name: get_sequence_leads
tools.description: Get Sequence Leads - List leads in a sequence. Supported filters: status. not_contacted/contacted are evaluated on the lead's first-outreach task (first email not yet sent / sent); opened/clicked/replied/bounced/unsubscribed match engagement recorded on any step of the sequence.

tools.name: unsubscribe_lead_from_sequence
tools.description: Unsubscribe Lead from Sequence - Unsubscribe a lead from a specific sequence

tools.name: unsubscribe_lead_globally
tools.description: Unsubscribe Lead Globally - Unsubscribe a lead from all sequences

tools.name: get_lead_messages
tools.description: Get Lead Message History - Message history for a lead in a sequence

tools.name: export_sequence_leads
tools.description: Export Sequence Leads - Export sequence leads as CSV

tools.name: update_sequence_status
tools.description: Update Sequence Status - Start, pause, stop, or archive a sequence. Setting status to ACTIVE starts sending emails to recipients and requires explicit user confirmation from the account holder.

tools.name: get_lead_activity_by_id
tools.description: Get Lead Activity by ID - Activity of a lead via lead ID

tools.name: get_lead_activity_by_email
tools.description: Get Lead Activity by Email - Retrieve activity for a lead using an email address instead of a lead ID.

tools.name: get_blocklist
tools.description: Get Blocklist - List blocked emails and domains

tools.name: add_to_blocklist
tools.description: Add to Blocklist - Add emails and/or domains to the blocklist

tools.name: remove_from_blocklist
tools.description: Remove from Blocklist - Remove a single email/domain from the blocklist. Only one entry per call, and requires explicit user confirmation, since the removed address becomes eligible for outreach again.

tools.name: check_blocklist
tools.description: Check Blocklist - Check whether an email is blocked

tools.name: delete_blocklist_entry
tools.description: Delete Blocklist Entry by ID - Remove a single blocklist entry by its ID. Requires explicit user confirmation, since the removed address becomes eligible for outreach again.

tools.name: verify_account
tools.description: Verify Current Account - Return information about the currently selected SalesBlink workspace account.

tools.name: list_my_workspaces
tools.description: List My Workspaces - Return every SalesBlink workspace available to the authenticated user, including its ID, name, and role.

tools.name: select_workspace
tools.description: Select Workspace - Set the SalesBlink workspace used by subsequent actions in this session. When omitted, the account's default workspace is used.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_sequence" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_all_lists, create_list, get_list, get_all_templates, get_template, get_inbox_threads, get_thread_messages, update_mail_state, get_all_senders, get_all_folders, add_contacts, remove_contact, get_sent_activity, get_opens_activity, get_replies_activity, get_inbox_placement_tests, get_sender_connect_link, get_bulk_senders_upload_link, get_signatures, fetch_sender_messages, fetch_multiple_sender_messages, get_sequence_leads, get_lead_messages, get_lead_activity_by_email, get_blocklist, check_blocklist · Private data: get_all_lists, create_list, get_list, create_template, update_template, send_reply, forward_inbox_message, create_sequence, add_contacts, remove_contact, archive_contact, get_leads, update_lead, get_api_keys, get_api_key_page_link, get_api_key_refresh_link, delete_api_key · Public sink: get_all_lists, create_list, get_list, get_all_templates, create_template, get_template, update_template, send_reply, forward_inbox_message, create_sequence, get_all_senders, get_all_folders, add_contacts, remove_contact, get_opens_activity, get_replies_activity, archive_template, create_inbox_placement_test, create_folder, get_sender_connect_link, get_bulk_senders_upload_link, get_signatures, update_sender, get_sequence_leads, get_lead_activity_by_email, remove_from_blocklist, check_blocklist · Destructive: remove_contact, archive_list, archive_contact, delete_inbox_placement_test, delete_api_key, get_remove_card_login_link, remove_from_blocklist, delete_blocklist_entry.
